orcs.method: Quintic fade aligned with the bottle, rotated 25 degrees clockwise; color at the lower left fades to black at the upper right over 85% of the interior.
orcs.formula: angle = radians(rotation_clockwise); depth = rotation_center[1] - (x + 0.5 - rotation_center[0])*sin(angle) + (y + 0.5 - rotation_center[1])*cos(angle); t = clamp((depth - fade_top) / (interior_bottom - fade_top), 0, 1); RGB = glow_color * t*t*t*(t*(t*6-15)+10)

zombies.method: Bottle-aligned white gradient, rotated 25 degrees clockwise. White stays bright through the bottom 10%, then fades with quadratic falloff to black at 100% up the axis.
zombies.formula: angle = radians(rotation_clockwise); depth = rotation_center[1] - (x + 0.5 - rotation_center[0])*sin(angle) + (y + 0.5 - rotation_center[1])*cos(angle); up = (interior_bottom - depth) / (interior_bottom - interior_top); t = clamp((up - fade_start_fraction) / (fade_end_fraction - fade_start_fraction), 0, 1); RGB = glow_color * (1-t)**fade_power
zombies.fade_fraction_origin: bottom of the badge interior, along the rotated bottle axis

_rim.method: Native status_effect_134 pixels; alpha multiplied by smoothstep from radius 23.25 to 24.5 around [27.5,27.5]. Outside 24.5 all RGBA pixels are unchanged.
_rim.interior_method: 255 where status_effect_134 alpha is 255, otherwise 0. Only the rim contributes to the antialiased outer edge.

_bottle_edge.method: Restore outline hidden beneath inventory + by interpolating adjacent native row profiles in premultiplied RGBA. Rows 47..63, center x linearly from 59 at row 46 to 45.5 at row 63; offsets floor(center)-2 through ceil(center)+5. Sample profiles at rows 46 and 63 with matching center-relative offsets. Clear patch footprint in marker mask before compositing. Apply before liquid and emblem.
